title: Plot Touches Given Effect by Round Reached, Weapon, and Sex — touchesgiven_effect
text: function investigates relationship pool stage offensive performance (touches_given) final tournament progression (round_reached). Analytical Rationale: competitive fencing, pool stage performance directly dictates initial seeding (ranking) direct elimination brackets. Fencers dominate pools higher volume touches given secure favorable seeds, bypassing early encounters top competitors displaying consistent performance gradient early pool elimination podium finishes (Bronze, Silver, Gold). visualization uses horizontal orientation (y = round_reached, x = mean_touches) minor vertical dodge adjustment (orientation = "y") prevent overlapping points lines sexes without distorting exact horizontal touch values.
